name: ClipWaltz
oneLiner: Drop in the photos and clips from your trip, event or launch, and ClipWaltz auto-edits them into a beat-synced, share-ready music video; no editing skills needed.
description: ClipWaltz is a cloud video maker with two tools. AutoWaltz turns your own photos and videos into a music video that cuts on the beat, with licensed music, templates and HD rendering done on ClipWaltz's servers. It also handles Insta360 360° footage, keeping the horizon level and following the action. Waltz AI creates brand-new video clips from a description or a photo, which you can enhance, arrange into scenes and export.
audience: Travel and event recap creators: people back from a trip, wedding, birthday or concert with hundreds of photos and clips they'll never edit by hand.
icp: Individual creators and casual posters (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) using a desktop browser, often with a phone or Insta360 camera. Expansion: real-estate agents, small-business product promos, coaches and creators, sports parents, and marketing teams needing frequent on-brand videos (Pro, workspaces).
painPoints: Editing apps are still work: sorting, trimming and syncing hundreds of clips takes hours.
Auto-videos get muted or taken down over unlicensed music.
360° footage (Insta360) needs desktop software to turn into a normal, shareable video.
desiredOutcome: A polished, postable music video in about a minute from raw footage, safe to publish, without learning an editor.
differentiators: Cloud rendering on ClipWaltz servers, not the user's device
A real auto-edit: beat-synced cuts, smart trim, Waltz to the Music pacing
Licensed music catalog that's safe to post
Insta360 support: split-lens pairs stitched, gyro horizon levelling, Front / Follow action / Tiny planet views
Waltz AI clip generation on self-hosted GPUs, in the same project as your own footage
Waltz AI Remix: AI lead-ins, living moments and extensions woven into your own finished videos, on the beat
competitors: Manual editing in a video editor

features.name: AutoWaltz auto-edit
features.whatItDoes: Assembles uploaded photos and videos into a music video with beat-synced cuts, smart trim, motion, transitions, filters, titles and fades.

features.name: Instant draft preview
features.whatItDoes: Plays the whole cut in the editor before rendering.
features.benefit: See and tweak it before committing.

features.name: Cloud HD render
features.whatItDoes: Renders 1080p 9:16 or 16:9 on ClipWaltz servers and notifies you (in-app, email, desktop) when ready.
features.benefit: Nothing to install; no waiting at the screen.

features.name: Occasion templates
features.whatItDoes: Trip, event/wedding, birthday and 'surprise me' starting points plus saved presets.
features.benefit: Start from a vibe that fits.

features.name: 360 camera support
features.whatItDoes: Converts Insta360 .insv/.insp files, stitches split-lens pairs, levels the horizon from the camera's gyro and reframes to Front, Follow action or Tiny planet.
features.benefit: Use 360 footage with no desktop software.

features.name: Waltz AI
features.whatItDoes: Text-to-video and image-to-video clips with style, camera, motion, length and quality controls.

features.name: Waltz AI Remix
features.whatItDoes: Pick any video you've made and weave AI into it: an AI lead-in that flows into the first shot, moments where a frame comes alive in place, and an AI extension past the last frame, with the song carried on under the AI parts.
features.benefit: Turn a finished video into something new without re-editing it.

features.name: Enhance
features.whatItDoes: Clean, Smooth (frame interpolation), Sharp (AI upscale) and Max Quality (AI Restore).

features.name: Versions, compare & scenes
features.whatItDoes: Version history, side-by-side compare, and storyboard scenes assembled into one video.

features.name: Exports
features.whatItDoes: MP4 or WebM at native, 720p or 1080p.

features.name: Share & community
features.whatItDoes: Share links, public feed, likes and comments, monthly theme challenge.

features.name: Post text
features.whatItDoes: AI-written description and hashtags for the post.
features.benefit: Ready to publish with copy and paste.

features.name: Workspaces
features.whatItDoes: Invite teammates with owner, admin, editor or viewer roles.

features.name: Google Drive backup
features.whatItDoes: Backs up original uploads to the user's Google Drive.

deployment: linuxg1 (pm2 clipwaltz :3100 + generation worker) behind a Cloudflare Tunnel at www.clipwaltz.com (apex → www 308); render worker on the AI box; AI inference on AISERVER; MinIO on linuxg7 with the media.clipwaltz.com edge

brand.voice: Warm, playful and confident (inferred from site copy: 'Let's Waltz', 'We waltz it', 'Done before your coffee'); confirm.
